The production pairs Miles Davis's original isolated trumpet recordings with a live orchestra and material from the documentary Miles Davis: Birth of the Cool. Jazzmobile's official Eventbrite listing identifies the venue as the Richard Rodgers Amphitheater in Marcus Garvey Park and frames the performance as a one-night-only Miles100 celebration. en.why_it_matters: This is a strange and compelling way to handle a centennial: Miles is not represented by a substitute trumpet soloist, but by his own isolated recorded horn placed inside new orchestral space, with documentary images and narration surrounding it. That makes the performance less like a repertory tribute and more like a live re-orchestration of historical presence. In Harlem, with the Miles Davis Estate directly involved and the event framed as a one-night Miles100 celebration, the cultural context is unusually specific.
en.trip_verdict: S. Protect the night if you are in New York; for a Miles-focused listener it can justify a dedicated regional trip, especially because the Harlem presentation is free and one-night-only. It stays below S+ because The Voice of Miles is an ongoing centennial production that premiered earlier in 2026 rather than a unique first or final performance.

es.why_it_matters: Es una forma muy rara y bastante poderosa de abordar un centenario: Miles no aparece sustituido por otro trompetista, sino mediante su propia trompeta aislada de grabaciones originales, colocada dentro de un nuevo espacio orquestal y rodeada por material documental. Eso vuelve la función menos un tributo de repertorio y más una reorquestación en vivo de una presencia histórica. En Harlem, con el Miles Davis Estate directamente involucrado y la noche planteada como celebración Miles100 de una sola fecha, el contexto cultural es especialmente preciso.
es.trip_verdict: S. Hay que proteger la noche si estás en Nueva York; para alguien muy metido en Miles sí puede justificar un viaje regional dedicado, sobre todo porque la presentación de Harlem es gratuita y de una sola noche. Se queda debajo de S+ porque The Voice of Miles es una producción de centenario activa que ya se estrenó antes en 2026, no una primera o última función irrepetible.
